name: NPower
description:
Offers tech fundamentals, cybersecurity, and cloud computing training for young adults and military veterans, with local NJ cohorts. They offer in-person, remote, and hybrid courses.

Eligibility Note:
While NPower primarily targets young adults aged 18 to 26 for standard technology training cohorts, they offer specialized programs specifically designed for military veterans and military spouses that feature flexible or expanded age criteria which bypass the standard young adult age cap.

Hours of Operation:
Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

name: Catalyte
description:
Catalyte provides free education and placement into software development roles. They offer in-person, remote, and hybrid courses.

Eligibility Note:
Catalyte does not require previous technical experience, college degrees, or resume screening for entry. Instead, applicants take a series of cognitive, problem-solving, and capability assessments designed to measure an individual's natural capacity for software development and technical learning.

Hours of Operation:
Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

name: Climb Hire
description:
A community-based program focused on training individuals for Salesforce administration and operations roles. They offer in-person, remote, and hybrid courses.

Program Note:
This program utilizes income share agreements, which means students pay bash upfront for tuition and only begin repaying the cost of the program as a fixed percentage of their income after they secure a well-paying job in their new field.

Hours of Operation:
Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

name: COOP Careers
location: Greater NYC / Tri-State Commuting Area (accessible to Monmouth County)
description:
A community-driven digital fellowship focused on launching careers in digital marketing, data analytics, and financial services for first-generation or low-income college graduates. They offer hybrid courses (combining live evening remote sessions with required monthly in-person regional programming).

Eligibility Note:
Candidates must live within a two-hour commuting distance of New York City and meet underemployment criteria (unemployed, working less than 35 hours a week, or earning under 0,000/year), making it fully accessible to eligible Monmouth County residents.

Hours of Operation:
Monday – Wednesday: 6:30 PM – 9:30 PM (Live Sessions)

name: The Knowledge House
description:
A tech training and fellowship program providing comprehensive pathways in coding, software engineering, data science, web development, and user design. They offer hybrid and in-person courses.

Eligibility Note:
While open to the broader tri-state area depending on specific fellowship grants (such as regional employer partnerships), applicants should verify local geographic and transit feasibility to physical hub locations, as some core tracks require regular in-person attendance.

Hours of Operation:
Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
